verdict.rationale: Vendor docs claim LlamaParse/LlamaExtract can pull tables into pandas DataFrames with source-page provenance and extract JSON matching a user-defined schema (llamaparse-docs-15, llamaparse-docs-3, llamaparse-docs-14), which maps well to 'typed rows for DB loading.' However, a hands-on community report says the opposite in practice: numbers can be extracted from tables but 'the output isn't provided in tabular format—access to the numbers is only available through question-answering' (llamaparse-comm-3), directly contradicting the clean-tabular-output claim. Missing for 10: independent benchmark confirming DataFrame/JSON table fidelity at scale, and no rebuttal to the community report showing the gap has been fixed.
